g.text: LEGEND - fill shapes with these exact colours, on the Level layer
jump up through it; any thickness
drops to the ground below it
draw 5; each one asks a question
hidden until the guide reveals it
only in levels with a secret
pickup; toss it to a wild Zebonky
big and sparkly; leads the way
1 x 2 tile box on the ground, number inside
same number = a pair; press Up to go through
One square = one 64 px tile. A shape fills a tile when it covers most of it; platforms only need a strip.
Any page size in 64 px steps: wide for a run, tall for a climb, or both. The camera follows either way.
The guide Zebonky runs from its start to waiting point 1, 2, 3... and reveals the exit door at the last one.
Only the Level layer is read. Grid and key, and Jump guides, are ignored - drag guides around freely.

g.inkscape:label: Jump guides
g.text: JUMP GUIDES - true reach with the current game physics
Max: 3.9 tiles across, 2.6 up (running, jump held)
Ledges up to 2 tiles high are an easy jump
2 up and 2 across together is safe
Door: stand in it, press Up. Invisible in the game.
